findings: F1-18-layer3: clock gating "must be done with special cells, not with an ordinary AND gate on the clock" → gate with a register clocked on the inactive edge feeding the gate (for a rising-edge clock, an AND gate), so only one gate input changes at a time; a clock enable is the safer choice when power is not the goal (D5 §2.2.3.5.1, §2.2.3.6)
F1-18-layer3: synchronizer "gives the first one a full cycle to settle" → nearly a full cycle (period minus setup time); lowers but cannot remove the failure probability (D3 "Synchronizers")

F1-18-hardware: clock tree "one of the chip's largest consumers of power" → dedicated low-skew clock routing; the clock switches every cycle (activity factor 1), so the clock network contributes to switching power (D5 §2.2.3, §2.2.3.5.1; D4)
F1-18-jargon: oscillator: clocks "often multiplied or divided on the chip" → on chips such as FPGAs, PLLs are the recommended source of internally generated clocks (D5 §2.2.3)

F1-18-layer3: STA "from the cell library's data ... without simulating any input values" → a timing analyser computes arrival and required times from cell and wire delays and reports slack (positive = met, negative = missed) (D6 §2.2.2, §1.1)
F1-18-breaks: "real delays vary with voltage, temperature and each chip" → removed (not found in an opened source) (—)
Not verified box: Layer 3 box: how real boards generate clocks (crystal, PLL, spread spectrum) and all their numbers; learner writes their own number.
Not found: How real boards make clocks (crystal, PLL multiplication, spread spectrum) and every number about it → unverified box kept.
Not found: Duty cycle definition (D1 not opened; not in D3 slides) → tagged as the chapter's own definition (W1).
Not found: That the clock network is "one of the chip's largest consumers of power" → not found; softened to "contributes a share of switching power" (D5 §2.2.3.5.1, D4).
Not found: That delays vary with voltage, temperature and each chip; that a processor's rated frequency is set "at the voltage and temperature the maker specifies" → not opened; removed.
Not found: That pipelining lets the clock run faster (D2 not opened; D3 "Parallelism" covers pipelining as temporal parallelism) → reworded.
Not found: Static timing analysis "without simulating any input values" in those words → reworded to D6: the analyser computes arrival and required times from delays.
